quantities.X_N: # legal microscopic extension/color-pattern states in the frozen family F_N under the frozen branch contract
quantities.K_N: # distinct canonical normalized proof-interface signatures SIGMA after the frozen normalization
quantities.poly_exponent_N: log(K_N)/log(N), defined for N>1 and K_N>=1

critical_firewalls: POLYNOMIAL_COMPRESSION requires an explicit constant d and representation/reconstruction argument establishing K(N)<=N^d (or an equivalent polynomial-size quotient).
Counting colorings/solutions is not counting algorithmic branches.
No complexity conclusion may be drawn from Lyapunov/escape-rate analogies.

SIGMA.name: CANONICAL_PROOF_INTERFACE_SIGNATURE
SIGMA.principle: Conservative quotient: collapse only symmetries proved irrelevant to future source-proof behavior; when uncertain, keep the distinction.
components: sorted set/multiset of surviving exact 3-list classes touching residual Y0
canonical incidence relation between those list classes (with multiplicity/count metadata) and connected residual-Y0 components
seed-color/type signatures relevant to future source lemmas
proof-relevant adjacency/nonadjacency relations between canonical representatives
bound C11/P7 local-geometry tags only when already sealed
multiplicity histograms/counts whenever future proof behavior may depend on them
normalization terminal/routing metadata relevant to the current local repair
quotient_allowed: vertex renaming preserving all partitions, colors, exact lists and proof-relevant relations
color renaming only under an explicitly verified automorphism of the entire colored seed/list interface
normalization-order labels that provably do not alter the final proof interface
quotient_forbidden: dropping multiplicity merely because vertices are false twins
merging different exact lists without a proved source symmetry
merging states with different future proof behavior
using graph isomorphism alone while ignoring seeded/list semantics

CHAOS_A.name: BRANCH_ENTROPY_TEST
CHAOS_A.pipeline: legal extensions -> frozen seed-two branch -> transferred Lemma10 normalization -> canonical SIGMA

CHAOS_B.name: SOURCE_VALID_SINGLE_MUTATION_BIFURCATION
admissible_mutations: one list/type choice only when source semantics permits it
CHAOS_B.target: find adjacent legal states with VI class-count <=1 versus >=2

CHAOS_C.name: NORMALIZATION_CONFLUENCE_TEST
CHAOS_C.target: when multiple source-legal normalization orders/choices exist, compare final SIGMA signatures
CHAOS_C.restriction: Do not invent nondeterminism where source normalization is deterministic.

promotion_rule: Every diagnostic pattern must go through a separate formal conjecture and arbitrary-N proof/counterexample gate before becoming authority.
